name: Plasma Chain Reaction
shortDescription: Tap unstable plasma cores to trigger chain reactions inside a dying star. 5 taps per level, shrinking explosions, 5 ball types, and roguelite upgrades that stack across levels.

suggestion.prompt: Theme: Unstable plasma cores drifting inside a dying star. Trigger chain reactions to prevent supernova. Gameplay: 5-tap budget per level. Explosions chain outward, shrinking each link. Ball types: Normal, Splitter, Shield, Ghost, Magnet. Mid-level events: gravity flip, black hole drift, rare golden ball (chain it — never tap — for bonus upgrade). Roguelite: After each level pick 1 of 3 upgrades (Bigger Bang, Echo pulse, Magnetism pull, Chain Freeze, Split Shield). Upgrades stack and combine. Visuals: Radial gradient balls with glowing cores. Teardrop particles with gravity. Shockwave rings. Screen shake. Rising pentatonic chain audio. Deep space background with parallax stars. Feel: Every chain should feel like a discovery. Rare events should make players want to tell someone what just happened.

improvements.description: Improved gameplay: round ends when all balls are gone, difficulty scaling with smaller explosions and faster balls at higher levels, mid-round wave spawning, and gravity well events for more player interaction.
Added Asteroids-style flying ship with swipe/arrow thrust, zero-g physics, 3 lives system, and double-tap/space explosions at ship position.

generation.notes: Built from approved community suggestion issue #277. Canvas-based chain reaction game with 5 ball types (Normal, Splitter, Shield, Ghost, Magnet, Golden), roguelite upgrade system (5 upgrades that stack), particle effects, shockwave rings, screen shake, parallax star background. Token counts are estimates.
